# TildaZ v0.8.1

**Faster output, and macOS starts at login again.**

- On Linux, a flood of output no longer waits for the next frame to be drawn: five
  of the six benchmark workloads run 1.5x to 2.5x faster on a 60 Hz laptop, and
  throughput no longer depends on the display refresh rate.
  ([#436](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/436))
- On macOS, "start at login" works again. Since v0.6.0 the launch agent pointed
  launchd at a process that exits immediately, and launchd took the real window
  process down with it. ([#442](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/442))
- On Windows, the Direct3D present call no longer holds the thread that parses
  output: ANSI-heavy output went from 37.3 to 65.2 MiB/s, and the spread across
  five runs fell from 214% to 8%.
  ([#435](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/435))

## Upgrade notes

- **macOS: allow both Input Monitoring and Accessibility again, or the hotkey will
  not work at all.** This build is signed with a new self-signed identity — the old
  key was lost when the login keychain was rotated — and macOS ties both grants to
  the signature, so re-enable TildaZ in both lists under System Settings > Privacy
  & Security, or run `tccutil reset All me.ensky0.tildaz` and allow it again. The
  hotkey needs one permission to see the key and the other to stop it also
  reaching the app in front; with only one of the two, macOS refuses the event tap
  outright. ([#444](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/444),
  [#109](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/109))
- **macOS: launch TildaZ once after installing.** The launch agent is only
  rewritten on a normal launch, so upgrading and then only logging in keeps the
  old one. ([#442](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/442))
- Windows: keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`, and the macOS artifact is still
  self-signed rather than Apple-notarized — both unchanged from v0.8.0.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.8.1-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.8.1-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.8.1-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.8.1-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.8.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.8.1-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.8.1-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.8.1-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
